title: Listening Drill — Collecting water samples — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Collecting water samples — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on collecting water samples. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Saturday. The group will now meet on Sunday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the canal bridge; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is labelled bottles. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow forty-five minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check sampling depth before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed sampling record so we can offer feedback.
